app_fee.value: The application fee is a non-refundable $89 for all GSAS applicants.
app_fee.quote: there is a non-refundable $89 application fee

fee_waiver.value: GSAS waives the application fee only case by case; international applicants can ask only on proven financial hardship, and approval is not guaranteed.
fee_waiver.quote: Applicants may be domestic or international students and must provide documentation that demonstrates that the application fee presents a financial hardship

also.quote: Fee waivers are granted at the discretion of GSAS Admissions and are not guaranteed

gre_general.value: GRE General is set per program, not for every applicant: Computer Science requires it and Biological Sciences makes it optional (see the program records).

toefl_min.value: For tests taken on or after January 21, 2026, the GSAS minimum is 5.0 on the new TOEFL scale.
toefl_min.quote: Taken on or after January 21, 2026 - Minimum score: 5.0

ielts_min.value: GSAS requires an IELTS Academic overall band of 7.0.

english_waiver.value: An undergraduate or graduate degree from a university in India is generally accepted as an exemption, but GSAS may still ask for test scores in some cases.
english_waiver.quote: you received an undergraduate or graduate degree from a university in India. (In some cases, we may request language proficiency test scores.)

notes: GSAS runs the PhD programs for arts and sciences; the CS and Biological Sciences PhDs are the only STEM PhDs in the GSAS programs-of-study list. Psychometrics and Quantitative Psychology (PhD) is a psychology program, not a listed field. The bulletin.fordham.edu doctoral list returned 502 and was not used.
